orders.admissibilityNote: Crosses a district boundary — needs the donor district to countersign before it can be approved.
orders.rationale: DH Karauli-01 can spare 42 co-packs (batch B010-DH001, expires in 516 days) while DH Sawai Madhopur-01 holds 13 co-packs against a 80% chance of running short within its 10-day resupply window. Moving them 125 km costs ₹2,698 and averts an expected 13.4 co-packs of unmet demand, cutting stock-out risk to 6%.

orders.rationale: DH Sawai Madhopur-01 needs 14 ampoules of Magnesium Sulphate and a vehicle is already going there from DH Karauli-01 with other stock. Adding 14 ampoules (batch B011-DH001, expires in 516 days) to that run costs ₹60 in picking and handling rather than a second ₹2,698 vehicle, and averts an expected 4.4 ampoules of unmet demand, cutting stock-out risk from 67% to 5%.
